new_capabilities: CSS selectors and direct/descendant text extraction

action_budget_calibration.reason: Two independent 8-step probes generated the checkpoint-2 implementation command at the final step but could not execute it.

difficulty_change.changed_experimental_factor: task difficulty, with the minimum action-budget increase required to avoid a deterministic submission-boundary floor effect

environment_fix.checkpoint_dependency_materialization: Merge public requirements from all retained checkpoints; checkpoint 2 adds cssselect.
environment_fix.kimi_tool_call_compatibility: Translate native Bash tool calls with empty text content into the single bash code block expected by MiniSWE.

decision_rule.probe_gate: Proceed only if a one-worker, one-layer native MiniSWE run reaches a non-zero checkpoint-2 Core score without infrastructure failure.
decision_rule.performance_signal: Compare layer-wise normalized Core score and full-pass workers between source_success and no_transfer.
decision_rule.complexity_signal: Compare received experience characters, total input tokens, model calls, and duration across layers.
decision_rule.causal_caution: This is a difficulty-escalation engineering probe, not final manuscript evidence.

interpretation: Kimi non-thinking two-arm contrast on xjq checkpoint 2, using the minimum calibrated 10-step budget needed to execute a generated implementation before evaluation.
